title.narrative: Supporting Pre and Post-COP29 Activities at the National and Global Level

description.narrative: The project aims at supporting the pre and post COP activities both nationally and globally. It will support the participation of Christian Aid staff and partners to participate in the side events while also follow in the proceedings across the specific thematic areas of interest such as Adaptation, Loss & Damage, Gender and Climate Change, transparency and accountability and innovation & Technology. After the COP29 event, the project will also support the post COP activities targeting the CSOs to unpack the COP29 outcome and support CSOs strategic engagements aligned to the COP outcomes and priorities. we will then be able to build a strong advocacy interventions aiming at monitoring the flow of climate finance and measure of transparency and accountability in the use of those finances.
